title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Long Term Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: PST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths." Key Responsibilities Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity. Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows. Build reusable patterns for: AI-assisted code generation Pull request automation Test generation Debugging workflows Developer self-service enablement Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback. Manage AI usage governance, including: Token budgeting and cost controls Usage monitoring and reporting PII redaction guardrails Audit logging and responsible AI practices Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations. Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms. Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization. Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings. Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management. Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar. Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong AWS experience, ideally including: Bedrock API Gateway Managed AI/Cloud Services Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred). Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence. Hands-on experience with: LLM Agents RAG pipelines Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models. Knowledge of AI governance and security, including: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs Prompt injection risks Model supply chain security Responsible AI controls Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Senior golang engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior golang engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping. As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery. By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity. Responsibilities Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture Skills Required Strong commercial experience with Golang Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or AWS SQS/SNS Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing Strong knowledge of relational databases Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams Nice to Have Experience with Python Familiarity with Mongo DB, Elasticsearch, Graph QL, or JVM languages Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully) This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider. To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country. Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Cloud engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Chat GPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Sys Ops Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior software engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base. Mission As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards. Key Responsibilities Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line. Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage. Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications. Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability. Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange. Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience. Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance. Whom Are We looking For We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You'll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value. Key Qualifications Node.js, Type Script & React Expertise: Extensive experience with Node JS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices. Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies. TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code. Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand. Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health. Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release. Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus. Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team. Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity. Bonus Qualifications Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads. AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions. Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus. Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

title: Support analyst l2 - bilingual
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Support analyst l2 - bilingual em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description Please submit resumes in English. Strong English speaking and writing communication skills are required. As a Support Analyst L2, you will troubleshoot operational issues with the Warehouse Management System (WMS), manage configurations, support cloud solutions, monitor SQL performance, and maintain documentation. You bring expertise with Oracle Web Logic Server, Oracle Databases, cloud services, Linux systems, supply chain technologies, and various hardware/software tools used in warehouse and distribution operations. What a day in the life looks like: Troubleshoot business and operational issues associated with the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and ancillary software. Quantify issues and provide supporting data if issues are escalated to the ERP Vendor. Manage the WMS environments and migration of configurations between environments. Support the operation and continuous improvement of the monitoring of our cloud solutions. SQL performance monitoring, index, and query tuning. Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, troubleshooting steps, and support processes for future reference and knowledgebase articles. What you bring to the team: BS/BA in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent; 5+ years of technical customer support experience. 3+ years of experience with SQL/Oracle. Advantage: Experience in software development. Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (AWS, Azure, OCI, Google Cloud). Advantage: Experience with supply chain, distribution, and interface technologies.

Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de planejamento em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Participar de reuniões com clientes e prestadores de serviço para definição de escopo de trabalhos, estimativa de prazos, recursos e interfaces com outras especialidades (elétrica, civil, eletrônica, caldeiraria, instrumentação) e necessidade de contratação de terceiros; Planejar a execução de trabalhos, no sentido de serem discutidos os aspectos de tempo, e estratégia e a adequação ao projeto objeto dele; Elaborar cronograma e controlar diariamente o andamento dos serviços; Elaborar relatórios de controle diariamente demonstrando para os envolvidos na execução dos trabalhos a situação; Programar os trabalhos a executar, considerando a natureza dos serviços, o material, as máquinas a serem utilizados, o tempo previsto para realização, o pessoal necessário à execução das tarefas, tendo em vista a melhor distribuição dos serviços e a execução mais racional das tarefas; Acompanhar trabalhos de manutenção, instalação e/ou modificação em equipamentos; Solicitar apoio de recursos durante os trabalhos, otimizando o tempo de ociosidade e uso; Levantar junto aos líderes técnicos as necessidades de reparar ferramentas utilizadas nos processos de manutenção; Participar do Programa de Controle da Qualidade – 5 S, fazendo o acompanhamento do setor, mantendo atualizado o arquivo, providenciando e cobrando dos responsáveis o atendimento para solução das não conformidades; Participar de análises de investigação de incidentes, acidentes, não conformidade, correções e ações corretivas.

title: Técnico de controle de qualidade
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de controle de qualidade em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Acompanhar a realização dos serviços de manutenção, garantindo o cumprimento dos planos de controle de qualidade, procedimentos internos, bem como a aplicação das normas e melhores práticas de engenharia; Apoiar a execução nas definições técnicas relativas aos serviços; Assegurar que toda documentação técnica definida no planejamento do serviço e/ou plano de controle de qualidade (protocolos, laudos, relatórios etc.) foi corretamente preenchida e aprovada conforme procedimento; Assegurar que o escopo dos trabalhos foi completamente realizado, inclusive os HOLD POINT; Assegurar que os sobressalentes, consumíveis, material de aplicação, componentes fabricados ou recuperados e demais serviços contratos foram entregues conforme especificado; Auxiliar no registro de todos os desvios técnicos e administrativos relativos aos trabalhos em RNC ou RNCE; Participar de análise e soluções de problemas registrados na RNC e/ou RNCE; Emitir documentações técnicas relativas aos serviços; Participar do Programa de Controle da Qualidade – 5 S, fazendo o acompanhamento do setor, mantendo atualizado o arquivo, providenciando e cobrando dos responsáveis o atendimento para solução das não conformidades; Participar de análises de investigação de falhas, incidentes, acidentes, não conformidade, correções e ações corretivas.

title: Executivo(a) comercial | feira de santana - bahia | liora energia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo(a) comercial | feira de santana - bahia | liora energia em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança. A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta. Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor. Você será a peça-chave para: Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética. Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza. Construir relações de confiança que duram. Principais Responsabilidades: Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante. Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto. Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível. Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora. Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente. O que Buscamos em Você: Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes. Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas. Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha. Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados. Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil Nossa Proposta de Valor: Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho. Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa. Seguro de Vida. Vale-Refeição/Alimentação. Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento. E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos? Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer! #Vem Pra Liora #Energia Simples #Transformação #Vendas Com Propósito

title: Executivo de vendas nordeste (base salvador, recife ou fortaleza)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo de vendas nordeste (base salvador, recife ou fortaleza) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

EXECUTIVO DE VENDAS (Nordeste - Base em Salvador, Recife ou Fortaleza). Prazer, somos a Pepperl+Fuchs . Somos uma multinacional alemã, líderes globais no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de sensoriamento e automação de processos industriais. Você quer tornar..... ... e ampliar seus limites ao mesmo tempo? Então você veio ao lugar certo! Podemos oferecer-lhe muito espaço para as suas ideias, excelentes possibilidades de desenvolvimento e desafios emocionantes. O QUE É NECESSÁRIO VOCÊ TER? · Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica ou Mecatrônica, Tecnólogo em Automação Industrial ou áreas afins. · Inglês Intermediário. QUEM NOS INSPIRA? · Pessoas pró ativas; · Com o perfil de fazer acontecer; · Que trabalhe bem em equipe; · Que possua capacidade de aprendizagem; · Pessoa analítica e com foco na solução de problemas. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER? · Realizará apresentações e interações de vendas (reuniões presenciais e/ou online) em todas as contas prioritárias, com foco na criação e fechamento de oportunidades consistentes com os requisitos da plataforma de vendas; · Fornecerá aos clientes informações sobre novos produtos, treinamento em tecnologia e participação ativa em lançamentos de novos produtos; · Utilizará recursos internos dentro do território designado, como Exposição Móvel, Vendas ou Representantes Técnicos; · Prospectará novos negócios, utilizando recursos internos e externos e acompanhamento de leads para crescimento de território; · Relatará as atividades diárias, gerenciará o pipeline de oportunidades e manterá contas prioritárias no CRM; · Apoiará os canais de vendas da região, representantes e distribuidores. EXPERIÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS: · Atendimento consultivo ao cliente; · Experiência com vendas; · Conhecimento aprofundado de automação e soluções; · Experiência com Canais de Vendas, Distribuidores, End Users e Representantes. A Pepperl+Fuchs oferece remuneração atrativa compatível com o mercado, além do seu PACOTE DE BENEFÍCIOS composto por: Assistência Médica - Omint Premium; Assistência Odontológica - Omint Premium; Convênio Farmácia; Vale Refeição; Bônus anual; Seguro de Vida; Cartão presente - Aniversário; Frutas e bebidas não alcoólicas no escritório; Celebração dos aniversariantes do mês, no escritório; Auxílio Educacional, conforme política vigente; Parceria com Sesc; Trabalho híbrido. Interessados candidatar-se no link da vaga.

title: Gerente de negócios pj
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de negócios pj em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quer fazer parte da Fintech referência em soluções inovadoras para gestão de pagamentos de folha? Somos uma instituição de pagamento 100% digital que possui a solidez do Grupo BSPAR. Nosso propósito é simplificar a gestão financeira de empresas e de contribuir para que as pessoas tenham acesso aos serviços financeiros de forma justa, simples e segura. Buscamos um(a) Gerente Comercial com perfil Hunter para atuar como protagonista na prospecção e fechamento de novos negócios. O(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver e executar estratégias comerciais agressivas, gerenciar o pipeline de vendas e expandir a base de clientes em Salvador - BA. Principais atividades: Desenvolver, monitorar e gerir de forma proativa o pipeline completo de vendas, assegurando a qualificação e priorização das oportunidades; Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas, desde a prospecção ativa de novos clientes até a negociação e fechamento dos contratos; Identificar e prospectar novos contratos e parcerias estratégicas, ampliando a presença da fintech no mercado; Liderar negociações comerciais, alinhando propostas e acordos que atendam aos interesses do negócio e dos clientes; Elaborar e implementar estratégias comerciais focadas na geração de novas oportunidades e no crescimento sustentável; Estabelecer e fortalecer parcerias estratégicas com players relevantes do mercado financeiro e tecnológico. O que buscamos: Disponibilidade para viagens e visitas presenciais; Conhecimento do mercado financeiro e/ou de benefícios voltado para clientes B2 B; Experiência comprovada na área comercial, vendas consultivas B2 B, especialmente em tecnologia, serviços financeiros e/ou produtos digitais; Ensino superior completo em Gestão Comercial, Administração ou áreas correlatas; CNH B e veículo próprio. Será um diferencial se você possuir: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CRM (ex: Hub Spot, Salesforce, Pipedrive); Conhecimento de mercado B2 B no NO/NE. O que oferecemos - Regime PJ: Fixo + ajuda de custos; Comissão variável; Wellhub.

title: Gerente suínocultura
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente suínocultura em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Dominar o manejo reprodutivo (cobertura, inseminação, diagnóstico de gestação), de crescimento, engorda e nutrição animal, sanidade e medicamentos. Principais Responsabilidades Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate). Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar). Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade. Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação. Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários. Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença. Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança. Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional. Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional. Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento. Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado. Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos). Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios. Garantir rentabilidade da operação. Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores. Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações. Garantir bem-estar animal. Atuar junto com fornecedores.

Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. title: Fx trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Médico cardiologista
description:

* OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉ DICO CARDIOLOGISTA (desejável RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\" Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em C ardiologia . Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. * SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! * O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos . Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológica s. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓ RIOS E PREFERÊ NCIAS DE HABILIDADES Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃ O EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊ NCIA MÉ DICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃ O EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ; ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos . Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO I MPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Cardiologia.

title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. description:

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Technical support engineer (analytics focused)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical support engineer (analytics focused) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company & Product Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both Saa S and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, Dev Ex, Data, and Infra. About Role and Team: As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. Responsibilities: ● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers ● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features) ● Manage critical issues that impact customer's business ● Work with R& D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product ● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers ● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community ● Work with Linux shell, Rest API, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents Work Hours: US East business hours. Main Skills (What You've Already Accomplished... So Far): ● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications ● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications ● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, My SQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level ● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, Business Objects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas ● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana ● You are familiar with Linux ● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers Nice to have: ● Experience with virtualization and cloud services (AWS, v Sphere) ● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically Java Script) ● Experience with No SQL databases such as Mongo DB or Hadoop ● Experience with Rest API ● Networking knowledges

title: Fund operations analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fund operations analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The RoleWe're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Fund Operations Analyst with 1 to 3 years of experience to join our team in São Paulo. This is a critical role in our firm's infrastructure, demanding both technical rigor and strong operational ownership.You will be a key member of our back-office team, working directly with the CFO and senior partners to ensure the efficiency, compliance, and scalability of our fund's operations. You will own the \"engine room\" of an international investment fund — managing offshore structures, investor relations, financial controls, and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.This role offers significant exposure to the full lifecycle of a growth-stage VC fund and direct interaction with world-class financial service providers.Key Responsibilities· Financial Management & Treasury — Own day-to-day treasury operations for both local (CNPJs) and offshore entities, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow management, FX operations, and bank reconciliations.· Fund Administration Management — Manage the relationship with external stakeholders of the fund's US entities, including Fund Administrators, legal counsel, tax advisors, and external auditors (Big 4).· Investor Relations (IR) Operations — Execute Capital Calls, Distributions, and NAV calculations. Lead LP onboarding (KYC/AML) and serve as the primary point of contact for investor inquiries and reporting.· Financial Reporting & Close — Lead monthly and quarterly close in coordination with external accountants. Review the fund's financial statements for accuracy and compliance (US GAAP / IFRS).· Legal & Governance — Review fund documents (agreements, side letters, subscription docs) and maintain the Data Room to ensure audit readiness at all times.· Fundraising Operations Support — Support capital raising processes, including Data Room management, LP due diligence coordination, and subscription document processing.· Process Improvement — Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and implement scalable processes and tools across the fund's back-office.Requirements· 1–3 years of experience in Fund Operations, Fund Administration, Audit (Big 4 or similar), or Corporate Finance / Treasury at a financial institution, investment fund, or large corporation.· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.· Exceptional organizational skills and precision in financial data management.· Advanced proficiency in Excel.· Ability to interpret financial statements, understand fund accounting principles, and flag risks proactively.· Ownership mentality — ability to manage multiple workflows autonomously and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

title: Full stack engineer (python/react/ai tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer (python/react/ai tools) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It's Like to Work at Yipit Data Yipit Data isn't a place for coasting — it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention About The Role We're looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/Java Script/Type Script, and AWS. You'll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they're not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You've shipped full-stack applications, you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software. As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‐edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you're not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you're in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices. You Are Likely To Succeed If You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, Type Script/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don't let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding toolsto ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
